headline: Arista Networks (ANET) Stock Could Stay Grounded On Fresh AI Demand News
summary: Arista Networks stock has delivered a very large 5 year return, yet current valuation checks show a mixed picture with the intrinsic value estimate sitting close to the market price while market multiples lean more expensive. Arista Networks has returned roughly 7x over the past 5 years, which puts extra focus on whether today’s price still reflects a reasonable long term expectation.
